name: Self Digital Footprint Baseline
description: Baseline of a person's own public username footprint, queued for ownership review and ended with a report.

inputs.name: username
inputs.label: Username (with consent or a documented case basis)

legal_notes: Applies to verified self-audits and consent-based engagements. Results are leads, not facts; nothing is verified automatically. Every run re-checks the subject's authorization, and revoking it switches the schedule off.
example_output: A de-duplicated dataset saved as evidence, with every finding linked to its source response.
capability_gaps: Published profile pages, documents and professional history are entered or imported by hand (see TP-05, TP-06); this template covers username presence only.
Steps marked as review are carried out by a person in the Target Profile screens; the automation does not perform them.

config.prompt: Open Target profile > Authorization. Confirm the authorization is current, covers the sources and identities this workflow uses, and matches the purpose. Expired or revoked authorization blocks every run.
Open Target profile > Review queue and mark each account Mine, Not mine or Unsure with a reason.
